1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora ornamental, de hojas grandes y ásperas que echa flores de color lila. En el área metropolitana le llaman belleza.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Ornamental climbing plant with large and rough leaves that produces lilac-colored flowers. In the metropolitan area, it is commonly referred to as "belleza".
